To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
BTTB inhibited degradation of formaldehyde treated 125I- bovine serum album in mouse liver lysosome.
BTTB inhibits protein degradation in mouse liver lysosome.
basic compounds (Bttb, chloroquine and methylamine) inhibit degradation of formaldehyde treated 125I- bovine serum albumine (denatured) in mouse liver lysosome.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of BTTB on lysosomal protein degradation.
the effect of basic compounds on the protein-degrading system in the lysosomes.
the effects of various basic compounds, including quaternary ammonio compounds, on degradation of denatured 125 I-BSA in mouse liver lysosomal fractions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
BTTB and vinblastine are inhibitors of protein degradation in mouse liver lysosome.
the degradation of denatured proteins is inhibited by the lysosomotropic agents.
the degradation of exogenously injected denatured 125IBSA in the liver lysosomes was inhibited by the basic compounds.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
lysosomal pH is an important factor in protein degradation in lysosome and that the inhibition of lysosomal protein degradation by basic compounds is closely related to their uptake into lysosomes.
the lysosomal enzyme system can be inhibited by the addition of various basic compounds.
the degradation of exogenously administered denatured proteins in lysosomes is inhibited by basic compounds, and this inhibition is caused by the uptake of the basic compounds into the lysosomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
BTTB can be used for studying the degradation of proteins in lysosomes.
the degradation of exogenously added denatured 125 I-BSA in lysosomes of mice is inhibited by BTTB, chlorquine, methylamine and ammonium chloride.
the degradation of an endogenous protein (labeled with 125I) in mouse liver lysosome is inhibited by BTTB, chloriquine, and other basic compounds.
